stem: The integral of sec^2 x / sqrt(1 + tan x) dx is equal to

verdicts.working: Let u = 1 + tan x, so du = sec²x dx. Then ∫u⁻¹ᐟ² du = 2√u + C.

working:
Let u = 1 + tan x, so du = sec^2 x dx. Integral = integral of u^(-1/2) du = 2 u^(1/2) + C = 2 sqrt(1 + tan x) + C.

Independent check: Let u = 1 + tan x, so du = sec²x dx. Then ∫u⁻¹ᐟ² du = 2√u + C.
solution:
Let $u=1+\tan x$, so $du=\sec^2 x\,dx$.
$$\int \frac{\sec^2 x}{\sqrt{1+\tan x}}\,dx=\int u^{-1/2}\,du=2\sqrt{u}+C=2\sqrt{1+\tan x}+C.$$
